resources.string: Do not disturb on a schedule
Every day the phone goes quiet at the first hour and comes back at the second. Alarms always ring.
Needs the do not disturb access of Android: turn it on to open the screen that gives it.
Calls and messages from contacts you starred still ring, and so does a second call within a quarter of an hour. Off: only alarms.
Always saves, and also removes the animations and the live content of the tiles: nothing moves by itself.

In the list, a message dragged to the right goes to the archive and to the left to the trash, with an undo for a few seconds. On a message that this takes the sideways swipe between the tabs; the titles still change tab.
